modal.title: Beta updates
modal.disclaimer:
### Beta Firmware Update Disclaimer
**Attention: the Remote must be restarted after enabling or disabling beta updates!**

By enabling beta firmware updates, you acknowledge and accept the following: 

1. Data Loss and Factory Reset.  
   Beta firmware updates may result in data loss and necessitate a factory reset of your device.
   It is recommended to back up all essential data before proceeding with beta firmware installation.

2. Use at Your Own Risk.  
   Beta firmware updates may contain bugs and unfinished or unstable features.
   We advise against installing beta software on devices used daily.

3. Support & Feedback.  
   We can't provide support for beta software. While support may be limited, we encourage users to provide feedback,
   report bugs, and share their experiences with beta firmware updates.
   Your input helps us improve the stability and performance of future releases.

Please note that issues can only be opened on GitHub with the appropriate tagging specifying it as a beta issue and providing the beta version number.
This ensures that feedback and bug reports are directed to the appropriate channels for beta testing purposes.

By proceeding with the installation of beta firmware updates, you agree to abide by the terms outlined in this disclaimer.
We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in helping us enhance our products and services.
